subject: Data sovereignty & DPA clarifications for onboarding
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Turner <liam.turner@finex.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Data sovereignty & DPA clarifications for onboarding

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier — excited to get Finex live with Redwood. Procurement has a couple of mandatory items we need clarified before we can create the PO and finish onboarding. Can you confirm the following by EOD Wednesday?

1) DPA: do you accept Redwood's standard DPA (I attached our template) or do you require your own? If you need your DPA signed, please attach a countersigned copy.

2) SOC 2: please share a link to your latest SOC 2 report (or a SOC 2 type II report summary) and indicate the date range covered.

3) Subprocessors: we need a current CSV/export of your subprocessor list (name, role, location, last audit date).

4) Data sovereignty: for EU customers, does your processing and backups remain in the EU (or within specific cloud regions)? If any data leaves the EU, can you list which services/processes do so and whether you use encryption with customer-controlled keys?

5) PO / Invoicing: Redwood needs the vendor to accept PO-based billing and Net 30. Please confirm invoice remit address and whether you require an invoice to reference a specific account code or DUNS. Also highlight any one-time onboarding fees so we can include them on the PO.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_template.pdf (redwood standard DPA)

Short answers are fine — procurement wants to avoid back-and-forth on these items. If you prefer, we can set a quick 15-min call.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_DPA_template.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Liam Turner <liam.turner@finex.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finex Payments Legal <legal@finex.io>
Date: 2028-06-20T13:02:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Data sovereignty & DPA clarifications for onboarding

Vanessa — thanks for the clear list. Responses below, and I attached the items you asked for.

1) DPA — We can sign Redwood's standard DPA. See attached countersigned copy (Finex_DPA_signed.pdf). We redlined a single clause about incident notification windows and accepted your language otherwise.

2) SOC 2 — Latest report (Type II) is here: https://s3.finex.io/reports/soc2-2027.pdf (coverage: 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31). If you need an encrypted download link / NDA to access the full report, let us know.

3) Subprocessors — Attached CSV (finex_subprocessors_202806.csv). Short summary: primary payment gateway (EU), analytics pipeline (US, but only pseudonymized data), backup storage in eu-west-1.

4) Data sovereignty — Core payment processing and backups are in eu-west-1. Analytics and non-PII telemetry may be processed in the US; all PII remains in EU and at-rest encrypted. We support customer-managed KMS for an additional integration step — happy to discuss.

5) PO / Invoicing — We accept PO-based billing and Net 30. Invoice remit: Finex Payments Ltd., Accounts Receivable, 12 Exchange Lane, London, UK, EC2M 5QW; invoices@finex.io. No onboarding fee for basic activation; there is a one-time premium connector fee (if you enable the customer-managed KMS) of GBP 2,000. Please reference Redwood account FIN-998 on the invoice.

Attached: Finex_DPA_signed.pdf, finex_subprocessors_202806.csv

Link to vendor portal for onboarding artifacts: https://vendor-portal.finex.io/onboarding/abcd1234

Happy to hop on a call if any of this needs more detail.

Cheers,
Liam Turner
Head of Partnerships
Finex Payments
[attachment: Finex_DPA_signed.pdf (application/pdf)]
[attachment: finex_subprocessors_202806.csv (text/csv)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data sovereignty & DPA clarifications for onboarding

Looping in legal for a quick review of the countersigned DPA and the SOC 2 link. A couple of notes from procurement/legal POV:
- We should confirm the incident notification timeline that Liam mentioned (gap here?).
- If they offer customer-managed KMS, that's preferable for EU customers needing extra control — Marcus, can you estimate the eng effort to support that connector if the customer requests it?

I can shepherd the PO once Vanessa confirms the invoice details and the connector fee if applicable.

—Ben
Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Turner <liam.turner@finex.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-22T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data sovereignty & DPA clarifications for onboarding

Thanks, Liam — that all looks good and answers procurement's questions. Two quick follow-ups before I issue the PO:

• Liam — can you confirm the incident notification SLA/expected timeline (hours) that you referenced in the DPA redline? Procurement needs that number to pass to InfoSec.
• Marcus — can you please confirm whether we can schedule the optional KMS connector for EU customers (estimate in engineering days)? Procurement will only include the premium connector fee on the PO if enabled.

If I haven't heard back by EOD Friday I will still issue the PO for the base activation and Net 30 invoices referencing FIN-998.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
